content:
For Apple users, storage never feels finished. iPhone photo libraries keep growing, Macs fill up with large projects and downloads, and the monthly services meant to solve the problem can become another subscription to track.

pCloud’s 4th of July promotion takes a different approach: pay once for lifetime cloud storage, then keep using it across your devices without monthly or annual renewal fees.

For a limited time, pCloud is offering up to 70% off its Individual Lifetime plans, and each plan includes pCloud Encryption for free for life. Storage options range from 1 TB to 10 TB.

Lifetime storage that fits into an Apple workflow

pCloud is a Swiss-based cloud storage service trusted by more than 24 million users worldwide.

It is built for people who need secure access to files across multiple devices, with apps for macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, and Android.

On the Mac, pCloud Drive works like a dedicated cloud drive for your files.

Instead of constantly moving files around or deciding what to delete from local storage, you can browse, open, edit, and manage files from pCloud Drive while keeping them available in the cloud.

That makes it especially useful for MacBook users who want more working space without costly internal storage.

On iPhone and iPad, pCloud’s mobile apps help keep your files close without keeping everything on-device.

Automatic photo uploads can back up your camera roll and free up local storage, while instant sync keeps files available across your Mac, iPhone, iPad, and other devices.

pCloud also operates from data centers in the United States and Luxembourg, giving users fast access to files while keeping security and privacy at the center of the service.

Backups, sharing, and collaboration without the subscription loop

Cloud storage is most useful when it does more than hold a folder of files.

pCloud includes automatic backups for important files, so your documents, photos, videos, and work projects have another layer of protection if something happens to a device.

Sharing is built in as well. You can send shared links to pCloud users and non-users, invite others into folders, or collect files with file requests.

That makes it practical for family photo collections, freelance work, client files, student projects, or any situation where you need to move large files without relying on email attachments.

pCloud also includes pDocs for editing and collaborating on documents in real time with other pCloud users, without needing a separate third-party editor.

A better home for photos, video, and music

For large photo libraries, pCloud Photos adds a more visual way to browse what you have stored.

Photos are organized by date in a smart gallery with a timeline, so you can jump back to specific years and browse older memories without digging through folder names.

You can also exclude selected folders from the gallery when you want more control over what appears there.

pCloud’s built-in photo editor lets you make quick edits directly in the cloud, including one-click filters, brightness and contrast changes, highlight and shadow controls, cropping, rotating, and flipping with real-time previews.

For media libraries, the integrated media player can stream audio and video files directly from pCloud.

You can also create playlists, making it easier to keep personal video archives, music libraries, or shared media collections available without downloading everything first.

Free zero-knowledge encryption for your most sensitive files

The standout part of this 4th of July deal is that pCloud Encryption is included for free for life with each discounted Lifetime plan.

pCloud Encryption is designed for your most sensitive files. It uses client-side, zero-knowledge encryption, which means files are encrypted on your device before they are uploaded, and only you hold the key.

Your confidential files live in a secure folder and can still be accessed from your devices when you need them.

That combination is what makes pCloud appealing for users who want both convenience and privacy. pCloud delivers everyday cloud access for normal files, plus stronger protection for documents, IDs, financial records, or other private files you do not want exposed.

Pricing and availability

pCloud’s 4th of July promotion runs from June 29 through July 8, 2026. Each discounted Individual Lifetime plan includes pCloud Encryption Lifetime for free:

  • 1 TB Individual Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $199, down from $664 [70% discount]
  • 2 TB Individual Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $299, down from $828 [64% discount]
  • 10 TB Individual Lifetime Plan + FREE pCloud Encryption Lifetime: $890, down from $2119 [58% discount]

If you are trying to cut down on monthly storage fees while keeping your files protected across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the web, pCloud’s lifetime storage deal is available now for a limited time.
